name: What kind of insulation is best for an attic conversion?

mainEntity.name: What kind of insulation is best for an attic conversion?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right insulation for an attic conversion is critical for comfort and energy efficiency, especially given our climate in the Bay Area. Options include spray foam, fiberglass batts, mineral wool, or rigid foam boards. Spray foam offers excellent sealing and high R-value, while fiberglass is a common, cost-effective choice. The best option depends on your budget, the attic's specific structure, and your desired energy performance. We assess your attic's unique characteristics to recommend the most effective and compliant insulation solutions.
